## Frontier safety for every layer of AI

[**Models** \\
\\
New capabilities bring failures your tests haven't seen\\
\\
Red teaming, RL environments and alignment data that train them out →](https://labs.alice.io/) [**Apps and agents** \\
\\
Off-the-shelf guardrails don't know your policies\\
\\
Red teaming and custom guardrails trained on your policies →](https://alice.io/solutions/apps-and-agents) [**Online platforms** \\
\\
AI makes abuse cheaper, faster and harder to spot\\
\\
Trust and safety for user-generated and AI-generated content →](https://alice.io/solutions/activefence-ugc) [**Personal AI** \\
\\
Personal assistants can fail those that rely on them\\
\\
Red teaming and guardrails for assistants and companions →](https://alice.io/solutions/ai-detection-response)

[**Rabbit Hole: our intelligence engine** \\
\\
Generic data gives generic safety. \\
\\
Rabbit Hole collects real attacks and uses them to secure your AI.\\
\\
See the intelligence behind Alice →](https://alice.io/intelligence)

Our story

## What we learn, we use to protect everyone else

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/6ad0c7a7a4c4f3747e70b482_hp-video-poster-headline.avif)

Rabbit Hole

### One intelligence layer  for real-world AI safety

Rabbit Hole, our adversarial network of in-house researchers and data, connects the online attacks with the real world.

ONLINE ATTACKS

### How attackers actually try to break AI

Researchers connecting billions of examples, stored in our database.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/69005ca0f0832195cbc1370c/6acf8451338320a280a70b71_Alice%20logo.svg)

### Only Alice   connects the two

Hundreds of researchers,

billions of examples.

THE REAL WORLD

### Using these attacks to make AI safe

Frontier models and enterprises test their agents against these real-world attacks.

[Dive deeper](https://alice.io/intelligence)

## AI belongs to everyone,   so should the safety required to trust it.
